notes: 98 playable vehicles with named years/trims and corrected model-specific rated power, torque, drivetrain, dimensions, and mass. Factory specs source-checking covers selected manufacturer/secondary references; other values are representative trim estimates pending independent model-level confirmation. Pricing explicitly distinguishes published U.S. MSRP from approximate U.S./international used, collector, or converted foreign launch figures. NONE of the estimated prices are live appraisals. Factory gear counts are modeled with generic ratio profiles rather than OEM ratios. Handling coefficients, brake force and boost pressure are gameplay calibrations, not factory specifications. Some weights are manufacturer dry, and some hybrid torque figures are ICE-only; fields label these exceptions. Provisional artwork associations remain marked and untouched. All 98 IDs, levels, dealerships and upgrades are retained.
